items.title: Adem Bona was solid as Turkey blew out Iceland in the final European 2027 World Cup Qualifier.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Adem Bona was solid as Turkey blew out Iceland in the final European 2027 World Cup Qualifier.

Bona: 8 points (1-for-1 from three!), 10 rebounds, 3 blocks.

items.title: Adem Bona: “Like, you can't call me from the States to Nigeria. He was like, ‘Yo, Sixers just got Bron,’ and I just started screaming at the top of my voice in the car while I had my brother with me, and we just started jumping in the car, and the car started bouncing, literally.”

items.author: Gina Mizell
items.body_excerpt:
In non-schedule release news, I popped by the Rico Hines Runs at UCLA yesterday. Sixers Labaron Philon, Adem Bona, Dominick Barlow and Caleb Love were all playing, while Justin Edwards, Jabari Walker, Ariel Hukporti and multiple staffers were on hand to watch. 

(This is Philon with the jumper)
